verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents exporting full general ledger and financial statements in Excel, CSV, and PDF formats (open/portable formats), which supports data portability. However, there's no evidence of full data export (all transactions, attachments, rules, integrations config, etc.) beyond ledger/statements, no bulk export API, and no explicit 'leave with your data' migration-out story (only migration-in from QuickBooks is documented). Missing for 10: full account data export beyond financial statements, documented API/bulk export endpoint, and explicit support for complete offboarding/data portability.
